commands.name: Get the coordinates of the highest temperature point in the area of interest
commands.remarks: Example: Select the range (0, 0) to (383, 287): 0x011f = 287; 0x017f = 383 1. When setting the coordinates, pay attention to the upper left (x1, y1) first and then the lower right (x2, y2). That is, x1< x2, y1<y2 2. When getting: min value, average value, max value, min x, min y, max x, max y. All are uint16 type

commands.name: Get the coordinates of the highest temperature point in the area of interest
commands.remarks: Example: Select the range (50, 50) to (333, 237): 0x0032=50; 0x014d=333; 0x00ed=237 Receipt: BE AA 0F 00 00D4 1F AE 6F E0 79 4C 00 D2 00 39 00 33 00 D3 F0 EB AA 0x1FD4 is the minimum value, 0x6FAE is the average value, and 0x79E0 is the maximum value. 0x004c, 0x00D2 are the minimum value coordinates, that is, (76, 210), 0x0039 and 0x0033 are the maximum value coordinates, that is, (51, 57)
